decisions.rationale: row_count 166158 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0 confirms whole rows are distinct; flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, and origin_airport are all null_rate 0.0 and together identify a scheduled flight instance without relying on nullable attributes like tail_number.

Aircraft attributes carry null_rate ~0.160426-0.176531 (unmatched registrations); destination reference attributes carry null_rate 0.02089 (unmatched destinations); all are retained as optional reference attributes.
tail_number has null_rate 0.009154 (1521 nulls), so it cannot serve as a required grain component.

captured_at has only 16 distinct values spanning a single minute in 2026, far outside the 2013 flight_date range, indicating an ingestion timestamp; it is described and retained as pipeline metadata though not flagged is_airbyte_metadata.
dep_delay_minutes (min -33) and arr_delay_minutes (min -86) include negative values representing early departures/arrivals, so no non_negative rule is proposed for either.

purpose: silver_flights holds one row per scheduled flight departing a New York-area airport (EWR, JFK, or LGA) between 2013-01-01 and 2013-06-30, combining schedule, actual timing, delay, and cancellation facts with carrier identity and aircraft and airport reference attributes enriched from registration and airport reference data.
usage: Read the table at the grain of one row per (flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport). Join on carrier_code or carrier_name for airline-level analysis, and on the aircraft or destination reference columns for fleet and route analysis, treating them as optional since they are null when no match was found. Treat dep_hhmm, arr_hhmm, dep_delay_minutes, arr_delay_minutes, and air_time_minutes as null when the flight did not complete as scheduled.
limitations: The profile confirms duplicate_row_rate 0.0 at the whole-row level, but the proposed grain is unverified until a deterministic measurement confirms no duplicates on (flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport). Aircraft attributes (manufacturer, model, manufacture_year, seat_count, engine_type) are missing for roughly 16-18% of rows where registration data did not match, and destination reference attributes are missing for about 2% of rows; these gaps could not be resolved from the profile alone. captured_at is retained as a pipeline ingestion timestamp despite not being flagged is_airbyte_metadata in the profile, and a reviewer should re-check that classification.
